event_markers.title: Fish population protection order M0238_2023 (lower Salmon River; M0239_2023 for Bessette Creek): about 398 surface and groundwater licence holders stop using water for forage crops.
Temporary protection order issued for the Salmon River.

New temporary protection order: 458 surface water and groundwater licences and transitioning groundwater users in the Salmon River watershed stop irrigating forage crops, lawns, fairways and gardens; effective 19 Aug 2026.
